bio:
I'm Arash Janatabadi, a Computer Engineer and a Bachelor's graduate from Islamic Azad University, Roudehen Branch, with a strong foundation in mathematics and physics.

I work in frontend web design and development using Next.js, HTML, and CSS, and have a specialized focus on Python programming. Beyond software development, I have hands-on experience in mobile hardware and software repair and have been actively trading in the Forex financial markets.

These diverse experiences have strengthened my analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.

My goal is to build fast, responsive, and user-friendly websites backed by clean code and precise programming logic. I'm based in Roudehen, Tehran, Iran, and open to collaborating on professional projects.
